title: Nijuuei

guide_target.label: 二重影（2000年オリジナルPC版）

routes.title: 桔梗ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 桔梗 END by the directly inspected SagaoZ walkthrough. The same walkthrough also documents a 桔梗 BAD END detour near the final-day heroine choice. This route is the source walkthrough's first full playthrough and establishes shared save points used to shorten later heroine clears.

routes.title: 命ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 命 END by SagaoZ. The optimized walkthrough branches from an earlier shared save and also documents 北条 END, 舞 BAD END, 命 BAD END, and イルスイ BAD END detours. These are ending detours within the overall 命-oriented walkthrough path, not separate main heroine routes.

routes.title: 楓玲ルート
routes.notes: Main heroine ending labeled 楓玲 END by SagaoZ. The optimized walkthrough branches from a save created during the 命 path and documents a 楓玲 BAD END before the main 楓玲 END. The save reuse is a guide optimization rather than a confirmed hard in-game unlock prerequisite.

sources.title: 二重影 攻略 by 愚者の館（アーカイブ）
sources.notes: Primary Set A. Directly inspected complete Japanese walkthrough for ケロQ 二重影. It explicitly reports 確認バージョン「修正なし」 and 状況「完了（ＣＧ・回想１００％）」, and contains separate 桔梗・命・楓玲 sections with movement/action sequences, timed choices, saves, heroine bad ends, main heroine ends, 北条 END, 舞 BAD END, and イルスイ BAD END.

sources.title: 二重影攻略 - BIGLOBE
sources.notes: Primary Set B. Independent directly inspected 12-day Japanese walkthrough. It documents the day-by-day navigation/action flow, heroine-affection choices (including 桔梗・命・楓玲 and 紗枝), the day-11 final quiz, heroine selection by highest affection, the 陵辱 vs ハッピー ending branch, and the Il-Sui rescue/failure sequence. Its route presentation differs substantially from SagaoZ, providing an independent cross-check rather than a derivative copy.

sources.title: ゲーム攻略＿二重影 (Destiny-Tiar / Infoseek mirror)

disagreements: RESEARCH GATE SATISFIED: SagaoZ is accepted Set A and the independent BIGLOBE walkthrough is accepted Set B. The two guides use different optimization strategies: SagaoZ gives separate completion routes and often chooses route-neutral alternatives that avoid unrelated affection/CG events, while BIGLOBE presents one 12-day framework, annotates affinity increases, and explains how late affinity choices select 桔梗・命・楓玲. Route authoring must preserve exact source text rather than pretending the two paths are identical. Route-defining agreement is strong: BIGLOBE independently documents 桔梗-affinity choices on days 6/7/8/10/11, 命-affinity choices and the day-11 sword branch, 楓玲-affinity choices, the eight-answer final quiz, the heroine-specific day-12 陵辱/ハッピー split, and the Il-Sui rescue/failure sequence; SagaoZ independently reaches and names the corresponding heroine BAD END / heroine END outcomes. ROUTE-NEUTRAL DIFFERENCES: the guides sometimes take opposite early affinity/CG choices (for example the day-3 village option) or different valid timed-combat inputs. These differences must be called out where they appear rather than copied across source fields. ENDING PRESENTATION: BIGLOBE describes ～は俺と来い as 陵辱エンド and ～は十兵衛と一緒に行け as ハッピーエンド; SagaoZ labels the corresponding heroine outcomes [heroine] BAD END and [heroine] END. BIGLOBE also documents 紗枝エンド as an optional day-6 detour when her affinity event is taken; because SagaoZ's completion routes generally avoid/exit that branch, include it only where the chosen route state actually makes it reachable and preserve the source-basis distinction. TARGET: original 2000 Windows PC product family, not the 2002 console ports; no route-content difference between 初回版 and 通常版 packaging was directly verified.
